integrity.degree_basis: The same source states Hilbert's degree formula for multiple-root loci, which specializes to the displayed weighted binomial coefficient.
integrity.duality_basis: The full text of arXiv:1508.00202 states that the dual of the multiple-root locus with k double roots is the k-point secant variety of the rational normal curve.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1011.1564 lists version 1 on 2010-11-06.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source arXiv:1011.1564 is Algebraic Geometry with primary MSC 14M12.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary projective-dual degrees of proper secant varieties of a rational normal curve.
It does not classify the full polar or Euclidean-distance degree sequences.
The weighted-binomial mode calculation is elementary after the geometric dual-degree formula is known, so an unindexed combinatorics source may contain the same numerical mode.
title: A one-third law for maximal dual degree in the rational-normal secant tower
